claim_boundary: This proves a finite physical-row modular-web classifier. It proves no actual row-reuse lower bound, eligible mass, target packet, recurrence, skeleton, density, or interval gain.

exact_replay.boundary: This is a finite physical-row modular-web classifier. It proves no actual row-reuse lower bound, eligible mass, target packet, recurrence, density, or interval gain.
exact_replay.countermodel: arbitrarily many states can have disjoint physical h supports, so state mass alone cannot force an aggregate covering principle
exact_replay.high_reuse: each high-reuse row retains numerator multiplicities, divisor-eligible groups, distinct numerator avoidance, and gcd energy
exact_replay.physical_divisibility: at fixed nonzero h, integrality is exactly a|h; eligible distinct numerators are at most tau(|h|)
exact_replay.support_separation: low-reuse rows are a labelled physical-support-separation bank
